reviews.title: Serious room for improvement but definitely keeps processor cool!
reviews.comment: Installation: Intermediate Skill, (Mainly due to lack of info and instruction even online). Pros: - As stated it does provide a very stable cooling. I run a Ryzen 5800x3d and tested with Cinebench. Highest temp. was 85C (2 hour / all core test) & lowest was around 34C (Ambient was 75F). - Solid mounting solution. (Connecting the pump/cooling block to the processor.) - Very cool lighting without ARGB (30 built in). Has some pretty unique selectable options besides the standard rainbow, solid, etc. - Can be connected to your reset button on your case. - 3 wires run from the pump & one from the fans, Reducing the amount of wiring to deal with. - Can be connected to their AEOLUS ARGB/fan controller BUT requires a proprietary cable that isn't included with AIO, the fan/controller kit, or sold on the site. Cons: - Doesn't tell you that you need to hold down the reset button to put it in ARGB mode. - No option to refill coolant unless you remove copper cold plate and pray you have access to the fluid. - Does not connect to their AEOLUS ARGB/fan controller w/o their proprietary cable that isn't included with AIO, the fan/controller kit, or sold on the site. - Limited instructions, mainly drawings with virtually no descriptions. You can easily get lost if you are new to AIO installs. - Company doesn't sell matching fans for this AIO. Total Score: *** Stars =============================== Key: ***** Stars = Excellent Product! **** Stars = Great but has some minor flaws. *** Stars = Works as promised, has some flaws, seems okay. ** Stars = Functional junk with many flaws. * Star = Hot, smelly Garbage!
reviews.author: Midian

reviews.title: It's okay, not great
reviews.comment: It does what it's supposed too and that's keep the cpu cool. But the lights flicker when on static color if i go above 50% brightness. The rainbow wave color works fine but on static color (i run white) i can't go above 50% brightness or i get the flickering. I'll probably get a different cooler in the near future.
